ledger.note: 618: Shen Faxing, Sui governor of Wuxing Commandery, rises after Emperor Yang's death: he 'gathered the troops of the region (more than 60,000 men)' and 'occupied more than 10 commanderies', Piling among them (Shen Faxing page; infobox territory 'Zhejiang/Southern Jiangsu', 618-620). In fall 618 he sent messengers to Yang Tong. The page gives no season for the rising. [Reviewer ea-03-x: found year corrected from 619, the year of the King of Liang title, to 618, the year the page gives for the land.]

Fall 619: Shen Faxing proclaims himself King of Liang and sets his capital at Piling. 'By fall 619, with Sui having fallen earlier in the year', Shen declared himself king of Liang; infobox 'Title: King of Liang, declared 619'; era name Yankang 619-620. The land was held from 618 (found event).

ledger.note: 620: Li Zitong destroys the Liang. 'In 620, Li Zitong, who had by then claimed the title of Emperor of Wu' captured Jingkou (Shen page); 'Li crossed the Yangtze to attack Shen, who had his capital at Piling... Shen later committed suicide, and Li took over Shen's territory, roughly modern Zhejiang' (Li Zitong page).
